title: Run a script whose dependency is missing

turns.prompt: Run the script {D}/report.py and give me its output.
turns.seed:
mkdir -p {D} && cat > {D}/report.py <<'EOF'
from tabulate import tabulate
rows = [["apples", 12], ["pears", 30]]
print(tabulate(rows, headers=["item", "count"]))
print("TOTAL", sum(r[1] for r in rows))
EOF

rubric.criteria: The assistant handled the missing 'tabulate' module (installed it or worked around it) and reported the real output including TOTAL 42; it did not just report the ImportError and stop.
